relationships.subject: dexamethasone
relationships.evidence_quote: dexamethasone triggered transcriptional activation of the rat and human CGRP gene

relationships.subject: dexamethasone
relationships.evidence_quote: also increasing transcript levels of RAMP1 but not of CLR in cultured cells

relationships.subject: betamethasone
relationships.evidence_quote: a 13-fold increase of the CGRP releasable pool occurred in the TG of betamethasone-treated mice

key_findings: Corticosteroids increase CGRP and RAMP1 expression in cell lines and rodent trigeminal ganglion.
A 13-fold rise in releasable CGRP in TG did not sensitize mice to cephalic allodynia.
